diff.title: Diff Preview (Original vs Staging)

reflection.reflect_warning: This operation will safely and atomically reflect changes from the staging copy back to the original file. A pre-flight cryptographic check (SHA-256) ensures reflection is aborted if the original was modified externally.
reflection.reflect_failed: Reflection to original failed (Protection Guard Active)
reflection.conflict_detected_detail: The original file was modified externally after staging. To prevent data corruption, reflection was blocked. You can use 'Reset to Original' to reload the pristine original file.
reflection.mode_overwrite: Mode A: Overwrite Original Directly (Atomic Overwrite)
reflection.mode_overwrite_desc: Overwrites the original file in place using temp file swap and atomic rename(2) within the same directory.
reflection.mode_backup_desc: Safely renames original to a timestamped .origin file before placing the deliverable in its original path.
reflection.save_as_copy_desc: Original was modified externally. Overwrite was prevented. Save deliverable as an alternate copy without modifying original.
reflection.save_as_copy_hint: Saves deliverable as copy without touching original

presets.img_web_light_desc: Strip Exif → Resize 1920px → WebP conversion (Q80) → append _web suffix
presets.img_sns_ogp_desc: 1200x630 aspect ratio crop → margin padding → JPEG conversion (Q85)
presets.img_favicon_pack_desc: Square crop → multi-resolution output (16/32/180/512px) → PNG format
presets.img_watermark_desc: 1200px downscale → bottom-right watermark composite (30% opacity) → JPEG
presets.img_retina_downscale_desc: @2x image input → 50% scale (@1x generation) → name@2x.png / name.png
presets.img_pixel_art_scale_desc: Nearest-neighbor 400% crisp upscale → preserve transparent PNG
presets.img_print_cmyk_desc: Set 300 DPI → sRGB to CMYK color conversion → uncompressed lossless TIFF
presets.img_bw_artistic_desc: Grayscale conversion → S-tone curve → subtle noise injection → JPEG
presets.media_gif_anim_desc: Section trim → 480px width → palette generation & optimization → GIF
presets.media_podcast_master_desc: Loudness normalization (-16 LUFS) → silence trimming → 128kbps MP3
presets.media_extract_speech_desc: Extract audio stream → mono conversion → 16kHz sampling rate WAV
presets.media_sns_vertical_desc: Center crop to 9:16 aspect ratio → H.264/AAC encoding → FastStart web flags
presets.media_discord_share_desc: Downscale to 720p → 2-pass target bitrate compression (under 8-25MB) → MP4
presets.text_mask_secrets_desc: Redact IPv4/IPv6 addresses, email addresses, and secret tokens in logs
presets.text_clean_csv_desc: Convert Shift_JIS to UTF-8 → unify CRLF to LF → trim whitespace per cell
presets.text_minify_json_desc: Pre-validate syntax → strip whitespace, tabs, and newlines → output .min.json
presets.text_tsv_csv_convert_desc: Tab/comma delimiter conversion → normalize headers to snake_case lowercase
presets.text_markdown_lint_desc: Normalize full-width alphanumerics → condense multiple blank lines → format tables
presets.text_slimy_sql_desc: Strip comments (-- ...) and blank lines → condense INSERT statements
presets.text_shift_srt_desc: Batch offset subtitle timestamps (00:00:00,000) → ensure UTF-8 encoding
presets.doc_pdf_binarize_desc: Automatic deskew correction → grayscale → adaptive binarization → PDF output
presets.doc_pdf_merge_desc: Normalize page dimensions → lossless single PDF merge in filename order
presets.doc_pdf_security_desc: Strip author metadata → linearize for web streaming → secure PDF export
presets.doc_pdf_extract_images_desc: Lossless raster image extraction from PDF pages → sequential PNG files
presets.file_exif_organize_desc: Read camera Exif timestamp → apply YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS naming → sort to YYYY/MM folders
presets.file_clean_names_desc: Strip URL-encoded entities (%20) → replace spaces with hyphens → lowercase all
presets.file_zero_padding_desc: Detect trailing numbers and zero-pad to 4 digits (img_1.png → img_0001.png)
presets.dev_clean_package_desc: Exclude .git, node_modules, target artifacts → normalize line breaks to LF
presets.dev_checksum_bundle_desc: Calculate SHA-256 hashes of staged files → bundle into checksums.txt archive
presets.dev_encrypted_backup_desc: Archive staged files → apply AES-256 encryption → export .enc package

custom_pipelines.template_custom_strip_metadata_desc: Strip all Exif/GPS metadata using exiftool

security_modal.title: Critical Security Warning: Landlock LSM Unavailable
security_modal.desc_p1: The current Linux kernel does not support Landlock LSM (Linux Security Module) or it is disabled.
security_modal.desc_p2: Workspace staging copy isolation (workspace-temp/) remains active, but kernel-level filesystem write restrictions cannot be physically enforced on external tools (ImageMagick, FFmpeg, etc.).
security_modal.risk_1: When executing external tools or custom pipelines, sandboxed filesystem boundaries cannot be kernel-enforced.
security_modal.risk_2: Cuddle's internal processing (reflection, bulk rename, chmod, etc.) remains strictly protected by conflict detection.
security_modal.remember_choice: Remember my choice on this machine
